answers.reason: The senate decides on statutes, structure, and strategy of the whole university, not matters of the administration.
Members of the administration work on the budget, but budget planning rounds are not allocated as their specific body.
Appointment committees select candidates for vacant professorships, which is outside the domain of the administration.
Faculty councils decide on the affairs of one faculty, which is separate from the administration's domain.
The administration works on examinations, making the examination board their designated body for these matters.
